about: The backward run and left (milestone-1 task 55, the owner's answer of Oct 8): Run01_BackwardLeft with its stride shortened to 0.782 of the pack's (each foot's offset from the hips along the travel scaled about its mean), running about 3.9 m/s on the Hunter, slower than the forward run's 4.6, in place of the pack's 5.42; its cadence (18 source frames a cycle), lift, lean and upper body kept. A loop: its first and last frames are the same pose. Every frame a foot is planted (and the frame either side) kept as a key pose, so the inbetweening never moves a planted foot, and every third frame in the air; Cascadeur inbetweening the rest. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
